Colour only: geometry, topology, UCX and IDs from the source (max-dump-007.json). Panels: Artem's vertical-joint texture (colour/noise/look of one joint), rib COUNT per facade from this building's «Фасад ... KPP VPM texel 1000 px/m. No frame posts on this sheet (no AC08-style frame band). Address Prg_2 is a placeholder token.
